{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_float'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Exclude QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
sales_clean = sales[sales['revenue_float'] != 999999.99]

# Filter for completed orders from loyal customers
loyal_completed = sales_clean[
    (sales_clean['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') &
    (sales_clean['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue_float'].mean()

# Print result
mean_revenue"}
